lessons.title: 1. Pointers & References in C++
lessons.description: Understand raw pointers, address-of operator `&`, dereference `*`, and references `&`.

tests.name: test_swap_ref

source.name: cppreference.com — Pointer and member pointer types — address-of and indirection

learning_objectives: Obtain an object's address with the built-in & operator
Read and write the pointed-to object with the unary * indirection operator
Bind int& references to existing objects so functions mutate callers

exercises.question: Given `int value = 7;` and `int* ptr = &value;`, which expression reaches the number `value` holds *through the pointer*?
exercises.explanation: `*ptr` dereferences the address and yields the pointed-to object. `ptr` alone is the address, and `&value` just recomputes it.
